summary: Thorough E2E testing of new split user/admin auth flows. Backend: 19/19 new auth tests pass (test_auth_roles.py) plus 19/19 regression tests pass (test_backend.py after fixing existing admin fixture to use /auth/admin/login). Frontend: user register -> /my-bookings + header updates (My Bookings + Log out) verified, unauth /my-bookings -> /login redirect works, /login rejects admin creds with 403 + error toast, /admin/register wrong code stays with error, correct code STUDIO41-OWNER creates admin -> /admin/dashboard, /admin logged-out redirects to /admin/login, seeded admin login works and dashboard tabs (Reservations, Blocked) load, /admin/login rejects normal user with 'This account does not have admin access' toast. Full regression backend for booking/payments/admin remains green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~751 lines and could be split into routers (auth, bookings, admin, payments) for maintainability, but not urgent.

Frontend NavigationHeader only exposes nav-my-bookings/nav-logout when user.role === 'user'; admins logged in do NOT get a nav-logout in the top bar and must rely on the dashboard's own logout. Consider adding a global admin logout in header for consistency (minor UX).

context_for_next_testing_agent: New split-auth is implemented and fully working. Backend uses two endpoints: POST /api/auth/login (rejects admin 403) and POST /api/auth/admin/login (rejects non-admin 403). Register: /api/auth/register for users, /api/auth/admin/register with admin_code=STUDIO41-OWNER. Bearer token in localStorage as sm41_token; axios interceptor attaches it. /api/my/bookings requires auth (401) and only returns bookings whose user_id matches. Guest bookings (no token) still work and are NOT linked to users. Admin endpoints (GET /api/admin/reservations, PUT /api/settings) return 401 no-token / 403 user-token / 200 admin-token. Frontend routes: /register, /login, /admin/register, /admin/login, /my-bookings (user-only, redirects to /login if not logged in), /admin/dashboard (role-guarded). Test files: /app/backend/tests/test_auth_roles.py (new auth) and /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (regression, admin fixture updated).
